peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 8.6% above its local comparables; 85 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $780,000 ($1,610 psf, 484 sq ft; 10 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,437 psf (range $1,328–1,761); 12% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $84,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,150,000 ($1,512 psf, 753–775 sq ft; 14 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,438 psf (range $1,211–1,702); 5.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $56,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Pasir Ris MRT about 450 m, Tampines MRT about 1,640 m; closer than 61 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 10 within 2 km; nearest Elias Park Primary School about 500 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 190 m), more than 7 of 116 similar developments (the same as 19); nearest hawker centre Pasir Ris Central Hawker Centre about 700 m; nearest park Tampines Eco Green Park about 390 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Parktown Residence, 73 new sales, about 1,010 m; The Shorefront, 6 new sales, about 1,830 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 38 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 724 new sales and 505 resales (1,229 purchases); new sales were 58.9% of these purchases. Subsales (25) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 505 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 82 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 505 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 495 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+2%). Planning-area private resales −4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
